intro: A short checklist so you arrive ready. Most of it takes just a few minutes.

steps.title: Check your registration
steps.description: Make sure you've registered through the official form and received your confirmation email.

steps.title: Prepare your laptop
steps.description: Bring a laptop with a modern browser and a stable internet connection for the hands-on workshop.

steps.title: Create the required accounts
steps.description: Sign up for a free IBM Quantum account so you can run circuits on real quantum hardware during the workshop.

steps.title: Install or set up Qiskit
steps.description: Install Python 3.9+ and Qiskit locally, or plan to use the browser-based lab if you'd rather not install anything.

steps.title: Review the beginner resources
steps.description: Skim a few basics beforehand so the introductory sessions land better. No need to complete anything.

steps.title: Check event-day instructions
steps.description: Venue, timings and joining details are published as they're confirmed. Check back shortly before the event.
